Author: (Motilal Banarsidass, AITM series)
Description: An English translation of part of the Skanda-Purāṇa, supplying the Purāṇic and sacred-geography register rather than event-history.

Author: Adam Hardy
Description: A survey of Nagara and Dravida temple architecture whose chapter on Bhūmija temples places the Udayeśvara at the summit of that mode.

Author: Amit Kumar et al.
Description: A hydrological study of the Betwa catchment and the main technical source on the river's seasonal and long-term flow behaviour.

Author: Mahesh Singh
Description: A monograph on Bhoja's reign, court and cultural world; also the only source in the corpus that calls Udayāditya Bhoja's nephew.

Author: Rajkamal Prakashan
Description: A Hindi study of Bhoja as a literary and intellectual figure, quoting heavily from Sanskrit sources in Devanagari and IAST.

Book Title: Geo-Heritage of Udaypur: The Third Eye
Author: INTACH Bhopal
Description: INTACH's drone and total-station survey of the hill, fort wall, geology and colossal Naṭarāja — the authority for all site measurements.

Book Title: Iconography of the Hindus, Buddhists and Jains
Author: R. S. Gupte
Description: A systematic iconographic handbook used to identify the deities, attributes and postures carved on temple walls.

Author: INTACH Bhopal
Description: INTACH's first Udaypur volume, listing roughly fifty heritage structures with GPS points, inscriptions and condition notes.

Book Title: Jagta Hua Kasba / कथा उदयपुर — English translation
Author: Vijay Manohar Tiwari
Description: A first-person heritage-walk account of Udaypur, self-described as a work of opinion, and the main source for present-day village life and folklore.

Book Title: कथा उदयपुर (Jagta Hua Kasba) — Hindi original
Author: Vijay Manohar Tiwari
Description: The Hindi original of the same reportage, useful for direct quotation and for checking the translation.

Book Title: Long-term historic changes in climatic variables of Betwa Basin
Author: Suryavanshi, Pandey, Chaube & Joshi
Description: A climatological analysis of the basin over a 1901–2003 series, covering the rainfall and temperature trends behind the monsoon regime.

Book Title: The Cultural Heritage of Madhya Bharat
Author: D. R. Patil
Description: A short official survey of Madhya Bharat's history and antiquities, and an early printed notice of the Udayeśvara foundation.

Author: D. C. Ganguly
Description: The standard scholarly history of the dynasty and the authority for chronology, genealogy and the reign of Udayāditya.

Author: IJMR Journal
Description: A short recent article on Parmar origins and the agnikula myth, in The Academic: IJMR.

Author: Bhagwatilal Rajpurohit
Description: An English rendering of a Hindi study of Bhoja and Paramāra-period town planning and architecture.

Author: Raja Bhoja
Description: The Śilpaśāstra ascribed to Bhoja and one of the earliest texts to describe the Bhūmija temple form; the largest file in the corpus.

Book Title: A serpentine scimitar of letters from Udaypur
Author: Saarthak Singh
Description: A study of a newly discovered Udaypur inscription — a Sanskrit grammar chart coiled inside the body of a serpent.

Book Title: Some Paramāra Temples From Madhya Pradesh
Author: Swati Mondal Adhikari
Description: A study of Paramāra temples centred on Un, with comparative material on the Bhūmija style and the dynasty's decline.

Book Title: Art of the Paramaras of Malwa
Author: RK Sharma
Description: "Art of the Paramāras of Mālwa," edited by R.K. Sharma, is a scholarly collection of seminar papers exploring the history, architecture, and iconography of the Paramāra dynasty in Central India.

Author: edited by Harihar Vitthal Trivedi, published by ASI
Description: This book is a comprehensive epigraphical compilation featuring the texts, historical context, and analysis of copper-plate grants and stone inscriptions from the Paramāra dynasty across Mālava, Chandrāvatī, Vāgada, Bhinmal, and Jālōr.

Book Title: Temple Economics: Arthvyavstha of Mandir (Vol. I)
Author: Sandeep Singh
Description: A modern argument for temple-centred economic development — not about Udaypur, and excluded from the research to prevent false matches.

Author: Krishna Deva
Description: A concise national survey of North Indian temple styles that treats the Udayeśvara as the finest Paramāra example.

Author: Stella Kramrisch
Description: The first volume of the classic study of temple form and symbolism, including a measured plan of the Udayeśvara.

Author: Stella Kramrisch
Description: The second volume, covering mouldings, imagery and plates, with the Udayeśvara among its illustrated examples.

Book Title: The Udayeśvara Temple: Art, Architecture and Philosophy of the Śaiva Siddhānta
Author: Anupa Pande
Description: The full 199-page monograph on the temple — plan, sculpture, Śaiva Siddhānta theology, Śilpaśāstra translations — and the primary authority on the building.

Author: P. N. Shrivastav and Rajendra Verma
Description: The official district compilation and the baseline for geography, demography, agriculture, communities and administration.
